q1_issues.issue: The rule's premise builds the trigger event as a Skolem-function term — (Member (sk_blow $x) blow) (Agent (sk_blow $x) $x) — instead of the bare event variable every worked antecedent uses, so the premise cannot match an ordinary asserted blowing event and the rule is unfireable.

The intransitive subject of "blows" is given Agent, but wind is a non-volitional natural force (a gas in motion), which the intransitive-subject test routes to Patient alongside "smoke rose" and "the tide receded".

notes: The rest is right: "cold" and "unprepared" are left unfused as separate Member atoms on the individuals, Source carries "off the sea", night is the bare day-part symbol on Time, the transitive inanimate extinguisher keeps Agent, and During ties the response to its trigger.
